Today has been a special day for us that we finally got to play with AI in the stage.

notes.title: DevDiary 11

Today's DevDiary is to start off with the heart-hurting news that we would need to apologize for the delay of DEATH FIELD. 
First of all, thank you for your continuous interest in DEATH FIELD, and appreciate your waiting until the game release. We are originally supposed to release the game in this weekend but have found certain kinds of suspicious attack we could get from outside. Because of this, we needed more time to look back on the security side to ensure more improvements, thus sorry for the apologies but we will need to delay the game.
As all of you must understand that this decision wasn't easy for us to make. But as our intention of doing the game service is to deliver our consumers the best gaming experience. We think that we made the right choice, and very happy that we can't wait to serve you with the better gaming environment in future.
